column1: # ApplyLabelSpec.java spec for /C132E0278.fullbin (2026-11-04): replace *_unknown* labels with names from usage; unit fixes.

column5: Clears FlexCAN A IFLAG bit 7 (MB7, write-1-to-clear). No direct callers. Was flexcan_unknown1.
Clears FlexCAN A IFLAG bit 8 (MB8, write-1-to-clear). No direct callers. Was flexcan_unknown2.
Adds up to 256 bytes from diag_tx_ptr into the chlog_response_data checksum per call; returns 1 while bytes remain, then sends the CAN 0x351 response. Was diagnostic_tx_unknown.
Clears queue_len and queue_head of the 0x351 telemetry TX queue. Was queue_reset_unknown.
SIU PCR 0x8d + eTPU ch 0x1b PWM for the purge solenoid at 100000/CAL_evap_purge_pwm_period Hz. Was init_evap_purge_solenoid_unknown.

O2 no-activity helper: tracks pre-cat min/max; restarts (status |0x20, count = rate cal) when the swing exceeds CAL_obd_ii_o2_flatline_band, else on count 0 with a plausible pre/post pair sets status bit 0x10. Was o2_sensor_range_check_unknown.
Sets every LEA_knock_baseline_3d[8][8][6] cell to 2000. Was lea_reset3_unknown.
Reads an eTPU period-measurement channel: params 1, 5, 0xd, 0x11, 0x15 (24-bit) and 0, 0x14 (8-bit status). Was eTPU_read_batch_unknown.
EBI MCR + chip selects CS0-3 (BR/OR: 0x3ff80000, 0x20000000, 0x20800000, 0x30000000). Was init_ebi_unknown.
engine_is_running set when engine_period_90deg_us < this (rpm = 15e6/val) and engine_running_confirm_timer is 0. Was CAL_ecu_engine_running_threshold_unknown (uint8_t[2]).
engine_is_running cleared when engine_period_90deg_us > this (rpm = 15e6/val). Was typed u16_time_4us.
ign_comp_roughness_request (1/4 deg) = -roughness_delta_rpm_filtered * cal / 1000, capped by CAL_roughness_ign_adv_max. Was CAL_roughness_unknown7.
Roughness comp only while roughness_cycle_mean <= this (same units as roughness_cycle_mean). Was CAL_roughness_unknown4.
Roughness comp only while roughness_cycle_mean >= this. Was CAL_roughness_unknown5.
Roughness valid (flag 0x80) needs roughness_rise_count + roughness_fall_count >= this. Was CAL_roughness_unknown2.
Roughness inhibited (flag 0x8000) when roughness_cycle_period (samples) >= this. Was CAL_roughness_unknown8.
Roughness comp only while roughness_peak_valley_delta >= this (captured crank-speed units). Was CAL_roughness_unknown6.
A/C power demand at clutch engage = cal*40 (ac_compressor_power units, clipped 2000..ac_power_limit); the load ramp starts here. Was CAL_ac_unknown3.
Pedal track D/E zero-voltage learn: zero -= (zero - sample)*cal/256 when the sample is below the learned zero (floor 0xaa). Was CAL_sensor_pps_unknown1.
Learned APP sensor D zero (minimum) voltage. Was typed u16_factor_1/1023 (track E twin is a voltage).
Idle PI integral upper clamp: integral/0x2800 <= cal (integral>>10 = 10 mg/s, so cal is 100 mg/s). Was CAL_idle_air_control_unknown.
Idle PI integral lower clamp: integral/0x2800 >= -cal (100 mg/s).
idle_comp_moving_blend_rpm_high = idle target + cal*8. Was CAL_idle_unknown1.
idle_control_entry_rpm = idle target + cal*8. obd_ii_idle_speed_control_monitor also compares the raw value (no x8) with the rpm error - firmware unit mismatch. Was CAL_idle_unknown2.
idle_control_exit_rpm = idle target + cal*8. Was CAL_idle_unknown3.
idle_control_low_rpm = idle target + cal*8. Was CAL_idle_unknown4.
Cold idle learn (LEA_idle_cold_learning_coolant*) only while this < coolant_temp < CAL_idle_learn_temp_range[0]. Was CAL_idle_unknown6.
X axis (idle speed error + 0x8000, rpm) of CAL_idle_air_control_integral.
Idle PI integral step vs speed error (offset-binary, clipped -0x9f6..); added to idle_air_control_integral_term each CAL_idle_integral_update_period. Was CAL_idle_error_correction_unknown.
Variant coding COD[1] bits 2-3; decoded and re-encoded but never read. Was tps_config_unknown.
Write-only: cleared to 0 in engine_load, never read. Was load_unknown.
X axis (throttle position, tps_abs_b_smoothed) of CAL_closedloop_tps_correction_tour_manual. Was ..._X_unknown.
Biquad low-pass state producing tps_abs_b_smoothed (init_tps_biquad_filters). Was tps_unknown_history.
MIL request (obd_ii_mil_state_flags 0x40) hold after a DTC with config bit 0x20 confirms: obd_ii_dtc_event_timer_100ms = cal*10 (s). Was CAL_obd_ii_countdown_unknown.
Mode $2F 0x184 (starter relay) test timeout: 100 = 0.5 s at 200 Hz; at 0 sets obd_ii_mode2f_flags_state 0x2000. Was obd_ii_mode2f_184_timer_unknown.
Reloaded with CAL_ecu_obd_mode2F_timer while the engine turns, counts down at 200 Hz once stopped; engine-off Mode $2F tests need 0. Was timer_engine_off_unknown1.
P0116 uses CAL_obd_ii_P0116_coolant_deviation_max_coldstart while runtime_since_start < this. Was CAL_obd_ii_runtime_since_start_threshold_unknown.
Time the post-cat O2 has to go rich after the pre-cat does (200 Hz); expiry sets obd_ii_postcat_response_flags 0x20. Was CAL_cat_check_unknown4.
Bank 1 post-cat rich-response countdown (CAL_obd_ii_postcat_rich_response_time_max). Was o2_slow_response_timer_b1_a.
Bank 2 post-cat rich-response countdown. Was o2_slow_response_timer_b2_a.
O2 slow-response / post-cat response tests need runtime_since_start > this. Was CAL_obd_ii_o2_slow_response_runtime_limit_unknown.
O2 slow-response test needs obd_ii_maf_flow > this. Was ..._maf_limit_unknown2.
O2 slow-response test needs obd_ii_maf_flow < this. Was ..._maf_limit_unknown.
Cat/O2 monitors run only while obd_ii_atmospheric_baro > this (mbar). Was CAL_obd_ii_cat_unknown3.
Cat monitor minimum accumulated air vs engine-off coolant (compared with accum>>4, 16 g units). Was CAL_emissions_cat_efficiency_unknown1.
X axis (coolant_temp_engine_stopped) of CAL_obd_ii_cat_monitor_min_air_mass.
With CAL_obd_ii_standards_supported == 1: enables permanent DTC storage and the Mode $0A service. Was CAL_obd_ii_diag_unknown.
Lean jump scaling (IPS/manual CALs) applies while engine_run_timer_total < cal*36000 (100 ms), i.e. cal hours. Was CAL_closedloop_engine_run_learn_timer_unknown.
IIR weight (/256) of stft_bankN into stft_filter_q8_bankN (o2_fuel_learn_100ms). Was CAL_closedloop_stft_filter_unknown.
X axis (dca_tps_ramp_index>>2, 20 ms) of CAL_dca_tps_limit_ips_no_lc. Was CAL_dca_unknown_ips_nolc_X_time (typed 50 ms).
DCA throttle ramp step vs time for IPS cars without COD[0] bit 2; target = idle TPS delta + val*4 (1/1023). Was CAL_dca_unknown_ips_nolc.
X axis (dca_tps_ramp_index>>2, 20 ms) of CAL_dca_tps_limit_manual. Was typed 50 ms.
X axis (dca_tps_ramp_index>>2, 20 ms) of CAL_dca_tps_limit_ips. Was typed 50 ms.
DCA ends when dca_tps_ramp_index>>2 >= cal (20 ms steps). Was CAL_dca_ramp_timer_unknown.

Reloaded to 200 (1 s) while no TCU 0xC7 torque request is active or during an IPS shift; the 0xC7 limit is honoured only while non-zero. Counts in torque_model_200hz (was typed 10 ms). Was runaway_protection_timeout_unknown.
After a launch->race fallback (ABS 0xA8 state), toggles output siu_gpdo[0xcf] / obd_ii_relay_status bit 7 every 100 ms for 80 x 10 ms. Was vehicle_mode_timer_unknown3.
IPS: below this speed the brake must be pressed for the driver-input brake flag; cluster flag 0x20 (press brake) when stopped below it. Was CAL_cluster_brake_switch_max_speed_ips_unknown.
Engine speed reference update disabled while coolant_temp <= this. Was CAL_engine_speed_coolant_temp_unknown7.
Max gears between car_current_gear and the TC-recommended gear. Was CAL_slip_gear_offset_unknown (typed u8_gear).
Slip detection per gear only while slip_expected_engine_rpm_per_gear < this (rpm). Was CAL_slip_car_speed_unknown1 (typed 1/100 km/h).
Expected engine rpm per gear for slip detection (compared with idle target and 500 + 5*LEA threshold). Was typed 1/100 km/h.
TC per-gear intervention timer reset while |steering_angle| >= this (1/10 deg). Was CAL_slip_steering_angle_max_unknown.
eTPU shared data memory base (0xc3fcc000), used by eTPU_read/write_param helpers. Was eTPU_base_unknown.
ASCII "MPCH7FxBC320": C90FL standard flash driver ID string; no code references. Was processor_info_unknown.
